# BoringTools - Comprehensive Ecosystem Specification (llms-full.txt)

> Complete technical and architectural index of BoringTools (https://boringtoolsai.com).
> Maintained by Ayush Sharma (https://github.com/ius-sharma).

## Architectural Principles
- **Browser-Only Processing**: Heavy compute (video processing, OCR, audio trimming, PDF compilation) uses WebAssembly (FFmpeg WASM, Tesseract.js, LibreOffice WASM, PDF-Lib, marked, pdfjs-dist) directly in the user's browser client.
- **Privacy by Design**: No telemetry, no third-party data broker analytics, no forced logins.
- **Zero Latency**: Native UI with Next.js App Router, Tailwind CSS, and local state management via IndexedDB & LocalStorage.

## Comprehensive Tools Directory

### 1. Geography Quiz & Map Explorer
- URL: https://boringtoolsai.com/geography-quiz
- Category: Education
- Capabilities: Interactive SVG world map, capital guesser, flag identification, boundary drills, offline score saving.

### 2. Browser-Based Background Remover
- URL: https://boringtoolsai.com/background-remover
- Category: Media
- Capabilities: In-browser AI semantic segmentation (@imgly/background-removal) removing backgrounds from JPG/PNG without server uploads.

### 3. GIF Maker from Images
- URL: https://boringtoolsai.com/gif-maker
- Category: Media
- Capabilities: Multi-frame canvas animation assembler, frame delay control, text caption overlays, color quantization, client-side GIF export.

### 4. Image Compressor / Resizer
- URL: https://boringtoolsai.com/image-compressor
- Category: Media
- Capabilities: Lossy and lossless image compression, custom resolution scaling, WebP conversion, batch download.

### 5. Image to ASCII / Terminal Art Generator
- URL: https://boringtoolsai.com/image-to-ascii
- Category: Media
- Capabilities: Luminance mapping, custom character sets, colored ASCII rendering, TXT/HTML/PNG export.

### 6. PDF Intelligence Tool
- URL: https://boringtoolsai.com/pdf-intelligence-tool
- Category: Documents
- Capabilities: Client-side text parsing (pdfjs-dist/unpdf), contact extractor, URL finder, reading stats, offline summary generator.

### 7. DOC to PDF Converter
- URL: https://boringtoolsai.com/doc-to-pdf-converter
- Category: Documents
- Capabilities: In-browser LibreOffice WASM engine converts DOC/DOCX files directly to PDF with cross-origin isolation.

### 8. Document Data Extractor
- URL: https://boringtoolsai.com/document-data-extractor
- Category: Documents
- Capabilities: Regex and natural language pattern extraction for dates, currencies, emails, phone numbers, and raw tables.

### 9. JSON Formatter & Validator
- URL: https://boringtoolsai.com/json-formatter
- Category: Developer
- Capabilities: Syntax error highlighting, key sorting, indentation customization, minification, clipboard copy.

### 10. Fake Data Generator
- URL: https://boringtoolsai.com/fake-data-generator
- Category: Developer
- Capabilities: Synthetic persona generator, address generator, SQL INSERT script export, CSV dataset export.

### 11. Can I Trust This Website?
- URL: https://boringtoolsai.com/can-i-trust-this-website
- Category: Security
- Capabilities: Domain age estimation, SSL verification hints, phishing indicators, safety checklists.

### 12. Link Intelligence
- URL: https://boringtoolsai.com/link-intelligence
- Category: Security
- Capabilities: Query parameter parser, tracker stripper (UTM, gclid, fbclid), URL decoder, QR code generator.

### 13. Reaction Time & Mouse Accuracy Tester
- URL: https://boringtoolsai.com/reaction-time-tester
- Category: Productivity
- Capabilities: Millisecond visual reaction timer, target aim accuracy test, click speed CPS test, results summary card.

### 14. Playlist IQ (YouTube Playlist Analyzer)
- URL: https://boringtoolsai.com/youtube-playlist-analyzer
- Category: Education
- Capabilities: Total runtime calculator across 1x, 1.25x, 1.5x, 2x speeds, daily schedule planner, chapter breakdown.

### 15. Freelancer Pricing Calculator
- URL: https://boringtoolsai.com/freelancer-pricing-calculator
- Category: Finance
- Capabilities: Goal-based hourly rate formula (Expenses + Taxes + Profit Margin / Billable Hours).

### 16. BMI Calculator
- URL: https://boringtoolsai.com/bmi-calculator
- Category: Health
- Capabilities: Metric and imperial BMI calculation, WHO category classification, ideal weight range estimation.

### 17. SIP Calculator & EMI Calculator
- URLs: https://boringtoolsai.com/sip-calculator, https://boringtoolsai.com/emi-calculator
- Category: Finance
- Capabilities: Compound interest projection charts, monthly installment calculators, principal vs. interest breakdown.

### 18. Digital Time Capsule
- URL: https://boringtoolsai.com/digital-time-capsule
- Category: Time & Date
- Capabilities: AES-encrypted local storage time capsules with voice recordings, letters, and photos locked until future timestamps.

### 19. Cinematic AI Prompt Architect
- URL: https://boringtoolsai.com/cinematic-ai-prompt-architect
- Category: Creator Tools
- Capabilities: Lens, lighting, aspect ratio, camera angle, color grade, and render engine parameters builder.
